description: This script seeds initial data into a Flask application's database for development purposes, creating users, courses, lessons, enrollments, payments, recommendations cache, chat messages, and whiteboard sessions with events.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing application users with roles such as student and tutor.

classes.name: Course
classes.description: Course model representing educational courses, each with a title and description.

classes.name: Lesson
classes.description: Lesson model representing individual lessons within a course.

classes.name: Enrollment
classes.description: Enrollment model linking users to courses they are enrolled in.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Payment record for transactions related to course enrollment.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Model for chat messages exchanged within courses.

classes.name: WhiteboardEvent
classes.description: Events occurring on the whiteboard such as drawings.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function seeding initial data into the database.
